gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdia: Noto Sans Old Sogdian brings tall, crisp lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals and holds up even when shrunk. Noto Sans Old Sogdian reads smoothly over a long stretch, while Bevellier's stencil-cut, pipe-cleaner strokes stay up top as the sophisticated note.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Hairline strokes of one weight, like bent wire, define Bevellier. Noto Sans Old Turkic sits beside it chunky and tall, its open curves feeling graceful against sturdier, friendlier letters.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Bevellier draws every line with no stem-to-join contrast at all. Noto Sans Oriya has generous curve gaps and small letters nearly as tall as capitals, so a modest body size is enough.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-osage: Bevellier makes round letters whose rims match their stems, graceful and sophisticated. Noto Sans Osage fills lines with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves, so longer text should read in a friendly, open way.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Graceful, sophisticated Bevellier keeps its stroke width constant, stencil-flat and tightly spaced. Noto Sans Osmanya answers with oversized lowercase and wide, easy s turns, which should make longer text go down smoothly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmo: Flat, stencil-cut and tightly fitted, Bevellier looks like one monoline pen drawing. And Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong follows with a high-set x-height and rounds that gap open like a cracked bangle, a contemporary counterpoint.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Bevellier looks drawn with a single pen tip, graceful and stencil-flat. Noto Sans Palmyrene lays curves that stop short and compressed ascenders beneath it, giving the page a modern, clean footing.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-ha: Bevellier's curves carry no stress at all, just flat stencil-cut strokes packed tightly together. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau is the one for open-ended curves and a short step up to capitals, so it handles the working text while Bevellier handles the display.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Bevellier's pencil-like lines never thicken or thin, and its lowercase looks wide. Noto Sans PhagsPa does the reading, with see-through openings and gently rising capitals.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Straight-edged, constant strokes make Bevellier look stencil-cut, graceful and tightly spaced. And Noto Sans Phoenician has generous lowercase height with wide-open s curves, so its size can stay modest.
